olivia: Heads-up — I've queued a batch of docs PRs that touch SDK snippets for streaming + pagination + retry logic across py/ts/go. Need quick triage on which ones are safe to merge without API churn.
kevin: skimmed the list, looks like 3 PRs are pure docs, 2 change examples to the new streaming iterator. which ones are you worried about?
sam: tagging in the PR numbers would help. also, we should standardize the pagination example shape. current py/ts/go snippets differ a lot.
olivia: good point — PRs: #4123 (py streaming update), #4129 (ts pagination rework), #4132 (go retry backoff doc), #4138 (crosslang snippet harmonize). I think #4138 is the big one — rewrites examples to use the unified iterator pattern.
mia: can we have a tiny canonical snippet we can reference in all three? i can do a one-liner per language.
doc-bot: Reminder: docs lint step will auto-fail if code blocks don't pass quick-run checks (py3.10, node14, go1.20).
kevin: here's a compact canonical streaming + pagination example for reference — please sanity-check:
```py
# python streaming + pagination (canonical)
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
it = c.responses.stream(model="open-llm-1", input="Summarize chat logs")
for chunk in it:
    if chunk.type == "token":
        print(chunk.text, end="")
# pagination (cursor)
pages = c.embeddings.list(dataset_id="d1")
while pages:
    for item in pages.items:
        process(item)
    pages = pages.next_page()
```
kevin: TS version (compact):
```ts
// typescript streaming + pagination
const c = new RedwoodClient()
for await (const tok of c.responses.stream({ model: 'open-llm-1', input: 'Summarize' })) {
  process.stdout.write(tok.text)
}
let page = await c.embeddings.list({ datasetId: 'd1' })
while (page) {
  page.items.forEach(process)
  page = await page.next()
}
```
sam: Go snippet looks fine but callouts: make sure we use context.Context for cancellation in streaming example and illustrate retry with exponential backoff in go PR #4132.
jay: I can patch #4132 to add a tiny backoff helper and a comment: `// retry: exponential backoff, max 3 tries` — keep it short.
mia: I'm drafting a harmonization checklist: (1) same high-level behavior for all three snippets, (2) add one-liner compatibility notes (minimum supported SDK versions), (3) small tests that run in CI (smoke).
doc-bot: CI note: new snippet tests need to be added under docs/snippets/smoke; allocate 1 extra minute to CI budget.
kevin: decision: merge #4123 and #4132 after jay's retry comment. Hold #4138 until we confirm the iterator API won't change in next runtime deploy (deploy scheduled tomorrow). #4129 (ts pagination) can be merged if it references the canonical snippet instead of reimplementing.
olivia: sounds good. can someone file a short follow-up to re-run crosslang examples after tomorrow's deploy? i'd like a quick checklist for oncall to run.
jay: i'll take follow-up and add a tiny bash script in the PR description to run smoke checks. cc @kevin for review.
sam: thanks — once merged, i'll run a sweep to replace duplicated pagination docs that i found in the repo.
mia: PR owners — please add a `compat` note at the top of each snippet block with the SDK minimum version. saves future confusion.
kevin: :thumbsup: will add to the review checklist.
olivia: awesome, team. i'll mark the queue and add a short note in the release notes about docs changes.
doc-bot: Deploy scheduled: runtime v1.14 -> v1.15 at 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z. If any snippet depends on new streaming contract, hold merges until post-deploy confirmation.
kevin: copy. will hold #4138.
olivia: thanks everyone — closing this thread, will follow up after deploy. :sparkles:
